statements.deduction-consent-v2: I am the driver named on this paper. I have seen this charge: the reason, the amount, and the evidence and photos shown with it. I agree that I must pay this charge. I agree that the company may take this amount from my salary, a part each month, as shown on the deduction plan. This agreement is only for this charge. I can still object within the time written on this paper.
statements.receipt-dispute-v2: I am the driver named on this paper. I have received this charge and I have seen the reason, the evidence and the photos. I do not agree with this charge, for the reasons I wrote. My signature only shows that I received this paper. It does not mean that I agree. I can object within the time written on this paper.
statements.refusal-witness-v2: I saw this charge paper given to the driver named on it. The driver did not want to sign it or answer. The date and time of this record are set by the system.

consent.languageLabel: Language of the statement you sign
consent.photosNone: No photos attached to this charge.
consent.photosSeen: Look at the photos before you answer.
consent.readAloud: If you cannot read this, ask your supervisor to read it to you before you sign.
consent.acknowledge: I have read this statement (or it was read to me) and I agree to sign it.
consent.ksaRule: Saudi Labour Law applies to this charge. Damage or loss: at most 5 days of wage each month. Fines: at most 5 days of wage. All deductions together: at most half the wage. You have 15 working days to object.
consent.otherRule: The company limit applies to this charge. This rule still needs legal confirmation for this country.
consent.photoRequired: Add at least one photo of the damage before sending this charge to the driver.
